== Description ==
Greetings Friends and Neighbors!

In this episode of Dairy News, Hay Day's game designer Camilla will guide you through the new feature we call: The Valley! 

It is a quick and brief guide, but one that will help you get started on your journey through the Valley! Sit back and relax and if you watch it all the way through you should know the basics of the Valley!

New episodes of Dairy News will be posted as often as possible. Keeping you up to date with the latest in Hay Day!
